75332-christina-and-the-boys.title: Boys
75332-christina-and-the-boys.creator: Amy Le Feuvre
75332-christina-and-the-boys.description: A book by Amy Le Feuvre. been abroad since her mother's death, which took place when she was born. She had been brought up entirely by her old nurse, and though Bracken Towers held innumerable rooms of every sort and size, Christina had been limited to her two nurseries. She lived in them entirely and it was only during the last year that she had made acquaintance with the library.

arxiv-1804-02191.title: Effect of final state interactions on neutrino energy reconstruction at DUNE
arxiv-1804-02191.creator: Sabeeha Naaz, Anupam Yadav, Jyotsna Singh and R. B. Singh
arxiv-1804-02191.description: Abstract We quantitatively study the percentage of fake events present in CCQE and CCRes interactions and the impact of final state interactions on the neutrino oscillation parameters at DUNE. The effect of final-state interactions for DUNE oscillation physics is analysed in an ideal and realistic detector scenario.

arxiv-2104-12914.title: Inflationary evolution in quantum cosmology from FRLW supersymmetric models
arxiv-2104-12914.creator: N.E. Martínez-Pérez, C. Ramírez, V. Vázquez-Báez
arxiv-2104-12914.description: Abstract We consider inflationary scenarios for FRLW supersymetric models with a scalar field, whose Wheeler-DeWitt equation has analytic solutions. Following previous work of the authors, we analyse the setting of the scalar field as clock, leading to an effective time dependent wave function, and a time dependent mean value of the scale factor.

arxiv-2109-11613.title: The Formation of M101-alike Galaxies in the Cold Dark Matter Model
arxiv-2109-11613.creator: Dali Zhang, Yu Luo, Xi Kang, Han Qu
arxiv-2109-11613.description: Abstract The population of satellite galaxies in a host galaxy is a combination of the cumulative accretion of subhaloes and their associated star formation efficiencies, therefore, the luminosity distribution of satellites provides valuable information of both dark matter properties and star formation physics.

arxiv-2202-11064.title: Occupation similarity through bipartite graphs
arxiv-2202-11064.creator: Pavle Boškoski, Matija Perne, Tjaša Redek, Biljana Mileva Boshkoska
arxiv-2202-11064.description: Abstract . Similarity between occupations is a crucial piece of information when making career decisions. However, the notion of a single and unified occupation similarity measure is more of a limitation than an asset. The goal of the study is to assess multiple explainable occupation similarity measures that can provide different insights into inter-occupation relations.

arxiv-2206-01757.title: A Note on the Analytic Structure of Celestial Amplitudes
arxiv-2206-01757.creator: Jiayin Gu, Ying-Ying Li, Lian-Tao Wang
arxiv-2206-01757.description: Abstract Celestial amplitudes, obtained by applying Mellin transform and analytic continuation on “ordinary” amplitudes, have interesting properties which may provide useful insights on the underlying theory. Their analytic structures are thus of great interest and need to be better understood. In this paper, we critically examine the analytic structure of celestial amplitudes in a massless low-energy effective field theory.

arxiv-2402-16801.title: Craftax: A Lightning-Fast Benchmark for Open-Ended Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2402-16801.creator: Michael Matthews, Michael Beukman, Benjamin Ellis, Mikayel Samvelyan, Matthew Jackson, Samuel Coward, Jakob Foerster
arxiv-2402-16801.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Michael Matthews, Michael Beukman, Benjamin Ellis, Mikayel Samvelyan, Matthew Jackson, Samuel Coward, Jakob Foerster. Benchmarks play a crucial role in the development and analysis of reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms. We identify that existing benchmarks used for research into open-ended learning fall into one of two categories. Either they are too slow for meaningful research to be performed without enormous computational resources, like Crafter, NetHack and Minecraft, or they are not complex enough to pose a significant challenge, like Minigrid and Procgen.

arxiv-2404-13930.title: Chiral edge plasmons in quantum anomalous Hall insulators
arxiv-2404-13930.creator: Furu Zhang, Chenxi Ding, Jianhui Zhou, Yugui Yao
arxiv-2404-13930.description: Abstract We find that the Berry curvature splits the edge plasmons propagating along the opposite directions in quantum anomalous Hall insulators even with vanishing Chern number. When the bulk is insulating, only one unidirectional edge plasmon mode survives whose direction can be changed by external fields.

arxiv-2406-14861.title: Resilience of the Electric Grid through Trustable IoT-Coordinated Assets
arxiv-2406-14861.creator: Vineet J. Nair, Priyank Srivastava, Venkatesh Venkataramanan, Partha S. Sarker, Anurag Srivastava, Laurentiu D. Marinovici, Jun Zha, Christopher Irwin, Prateek Mittal, John Williams, Jayant Kumar, H. Vincent Poor, Anuradha M. Annaswamy
arxiv-2406-14861.description: Abstract The electricity grid has evolved from a physical system to a cyber-physical system with digital devices that perform measurement, control, communication, computation, and actuation. The increased penetration of distributed energy resources (DERs) including renewable generation, flexible loads, and storage provides extraordinary opportunities for improvements in efficiency and sustainability.

arxiv-2501-05018.title: Finding Needles in Emb(a)dding Haystacks: Legal Document Retrieval via Bagging and SVR Ensembles
arxiv-2501-05018.creator: Kevin Bönisch, Alexander Mehler
arxiv-2501-05018.description: Abstract We introduce a retrieval approach leveraging Support Vector Regression (SVR) ensembles, bootstrap aggregation (bagging), and embedding spaces on the German Dataset for Legal Information Retrieval (GerDaLIR). By conceptualizing the retrieval task in terms of multiple binary needle-in-a-haystack subtasks, we show improved recall over the baselines (0.849 > > 0.803 — 0.

arxiv-2507-18599.title: Laser micromachining of arbitrarily complex and overhang-free SiN nanomechanical resonators
arxiv-2507-18599.creator: Yahya Saleh 1, Zachary Louis-Seize 1, Timothy Hodges 1, David Girard 2, Mohammed Shakir 1, Mathis Turgeon-Roy 1, Francis Doyon-D’Amour 1, Chang Zhang 1, Arnaud Weck 1,2, Raphael St-Gelais 1,2
arxiv-2507-18599.description: Abstract Research on silicon nitride (SiN) nanomechanical resonators produces an exceptionally rich variety of resonator geometries, for which there is currently no available rapid prototyping solution. Experimental advances in nanobeam, trampoline, phononic bandgap, and soft-clamping structures all rely on conventional nanofabrication involving e-beam or photolithography, followed by various etching steps.

arxiv-2507-23647.title: Spectroscopic Signatures of Structural Disorder and Electron-Phonon Interactions in Trigonal Selenium Thin Films for Solar Energy Harvesting
arxiv-2507-23647.creator: Rasmus S. Nielsen, Axel G. Medaille, Arnau Torrens, Oriol Segura-Blanch, Seán R. Kavanagh, David O. Scanlon, Aron Walsh, Edgardo Saucedo, Marcel Placidi, Mirjana Dimitrievska
arxiv-2507-23647.description: Abstract Selenium is experiencing renewed interest as a elemental semiconductor for a range of optoelectronic and energy applications due to its irresistibly simple composition and favorable wide bandgap. However, its high volatility and low radiative efficiency make it challenging to assess structural and optoelectronic quality, calling for advanced, non-destructive characterization methods.

arxiv-2508-16473.title: Modelling the impact of synovial fluid elasticity on tangential stress
arxiv-2508-16473.creator: Eamonn A. Gaffney 1*, Cameron P. Brown 2, Jonathan P. Whiteley 3
arxiv-2508-16473.description: Abstract The rheological properties of synovial fluid have been observed to substantially impact its lubricating behaviour. While numerous studies have illustrated the importance of its shear-dependent viscosity, the impact of synovial fluid elasticity for oscillatory joint motion is far less characterised.

arxiv-2510-19581.title: Addressing the Depth-of-Field Constraint: A New Paradigm for High Resolution Multi-Focus Image Fusion
arxiv-2510-19581.creator: Luca Piano, Peng Huanwen, Radu Ciprian Bilcu, Huawei Technologies Oy (Finland) Company Ltd, Politecnico di Torino {luca.piano}@polito.it{penghuanwen}@huawei.com
arxiv-2510-19581.description: Abstract Multi-focus image fusion (MFIF) addresses the depth-of-field (DOF) limitations of optical lenses, where only objects within a specific range appear sharp. Although traditional and deep learning methods have advanced the field, challenges persist, including limited training data, domain gaps from synthetic datasets, and difficulties with regions lacking information.

arxiv-2511-21572.title: BAMAS: Structuring Budget-Aware Multi-Agent Systems
arxiv-2511-21572.creator: Liming Yang, Junyu Luo, Xuanzhe Liu, Yiling Lou, Zhenpeng Chen
arxiv-2511-21572.description: Abstract Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems have emerged as a powerful paradigm for enabling autonomous agents to solve complex tasks. As these systems scale in complexity, cost becomes an important consideration for practical deployment. However, existing work rarely addresses how to structure multi-agent systems under explicit budget constraints.

pmc-10647555.title: Vacuolar Sugar Transporter TMT2 Plays Crucial Roles in Germination and Seedling Development in Arabidopsis
pmc-10647555.creator: Yanting Cao, Jinju Hu, Jinrong Hou, Chenguang Fu, Xingyue Zou, Xuxia Han, Pulian Jia, Chenjie Sun, Yan Xu, Yuhan Xue, Yiming Zou, Xinyue Liu, Xueying Chen, Guoyang Li, Jianing Guo, Min Xu, Aigen Fu
pmc-10647555.description: Vacuolar sugar transporters transport sugar across the tonoplast, are major players in maintaining sugar homeostasis, and therefore play vital roles in plant growth, development, and biomass yield. In this study, we analyzed the physiological roles of the tonoplast monosaccharide transporter 2 (TMT2) in Arabidopsis.

pmc-10669883.title: A Novel Molecularly Imprinted Sensor Based on CuO Nanoparticles with Peroxidase-like Activity for the Selective Determination of Astragaloside-IV
pmc-10669883.creator: Guo-Ying Chen, Ling-Xiao Chen, Jin Gao, Chengyu Chen, Jianli Guan, Zhiming Cao, Yuanjia Hu, Feng-Qing Yang
pmc-10669883.description: In this work, dopamine (DA) was polymerized on the surface of CuO nanoparticles (CuO NPs) to form a molecularly imprinted polymer (MIP@PDA/CuO NPs) for the colorimetric detection of astragaloside-IV (AS-IV). The synthesis process of MIP is simple and easy to operate, without adding other monomers or initiators.

pmc-11710373.title: Search for the fourth elusive haplotype of the APO E2/E3/E4 polymorphism and its potential effect on AD risk
pmc-11710373.creator: Asma Naseer Cheema, Elizabeth C Lawrence, Narges Zafari, Kang‐Hsien Fan, Muhammad Muaaz Aslam, Vibha Acharya, Margaret A Bedison, Eleanor Feingold, M Ilyas Kamboh
pmc-11710373.description: BackgroundThe common APOE2/E3/E4 polymorphism, the strongest risk factor for Alzheimer’s disease (AD), is determined by two‐site haplotypes at codons 112 (Cys>Arg) and 158 (Arg>Cys), resulting into six genotypes. Due to strong linkage disequilibrium between the two sites, 3 of the 4 expected haplotypes (E2, E3, E4) have been observed and extensively studied in relation to AD risk.

pmc-12631170.creator: Osuke Arai, Yuta Yanagihara, Haruna Arai, Ryuta Watanabe, Noriyoshi Miura, Tadahiko Kikugawa, Takashi Saika, Yuuki Imai
pmc-12631170.description: BackgroundApproximately 83,000 new cases of bladder cancer (BC) in the United States and 23,000 in Japan are confirmed per year, and the number of new BC cases increases every year. While the prognosis for localized cancer is favorable, treatment options for metastatic cancer are limited, and the prognosis is extremely poor.

pmc-13000371.title: Two cases (a decade apart) of severe sulfonylurea-positive hypoglycemia associated with inhaled heroin use
pmc-13000371.creator: Brittany Weisbrot, Keun Young Kim, Christine Zacharia, Jessica L Hwang
pmc-13000371.description: Hypoglycemic disorders in nondiabetic patients are rare. In the setting of concomitant illicit opioid abuse, hypoglycemia is highly unusual, and an underlying cause should be systematically investigated. We report 2 unique admissions (separated by a decade in time) to the intensive care unit for critical hypoglycemia secondary unintentional sulfonylurea exposure after heroin use.

pmc-13287512.title: Long-term pulmonary function after intrathoracic versus extrathoracic LVAD Implantation: perioperative implications at one year
pmc-13287512.creator: Kimito Minami, Tatsutoshi Shimatani, Masahiro Kazawa, Naoki Tadokoro, Satsuki Fukushima, Takuma Sato, Yasumasa Tsukamoto, Muneyuki Takeuchi
pmc-13287512.description: BackgroundPatients undergoing durable left ventricular assist device (LVAD) implantation frequently require prolonged perioperative respiratory support. However, the long-term pulmonary consequences of different surgical pump placement strategies remain unclear. We investigated longitudinal pulmonary function changes following intrathoracic versus extrathoracic LVAD implantation.
